name: Obsidian-FHD
description:
Obsidian FHD: a modern 1080p skin for enigma2 (OpenPLi, OpenATV and other images)
A dark "Obsidian Telemetry" skin: OLED-black canvas, electric-cyan and RF-amber accents, Inter for text and JetBrains Mono for technical data. It is built on the structure of PLi-FullNightHD, the reference Full HD skin maintained by OpenPLi, so all of its ~480 screen and plugin definitions use widget names that the OpenPLi code expects.

Resolution: 1920×1080 (the box must support Full HD skins)
Fonts: Inter, JetBrains Mono and Noto Kufi Arabic (for Arabic text) ship inside the skin (SIL OFL licence).
Weather (optional): with the OAWeather plugin installed, the infobar shows the current weather in the top-left corner and the OAWeather screens use the Obsidian style. Without the plugin, nothing changes.
author: dali44g
